newsitem.title: UK: London Stock Exchange director Vardey resigns.
newsitem.headline: London Stock Exchange director Vardey resigns.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange said on Friday that Giles Vardey, director of markets development and marketing, had tendered his resignation and would leave his post at the end of March next year.
The LSE said Vardey played a leading role in developing its new trading services.
Exchange sources said Vardey was expected to resume his career in the securities industry and was likely to receive approaches from companies in London's financial centre.
Vardey has been director of marketing since December 1992.
